captions.detailed: A portable rectangular air purifier featuring a light gray outer shell, a front-opening door on side hinges, and an internal filter cartridge. A black folding handle is integrated into a recessed pocket at the top of the shell, rotating upward on two small pivots. The front door swings open on its vertical axis, while the filter cartridge slides horizontally out of the main compartment.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a rectangular portable air purifier with a light gray body. The model must include a front door rotating on side hinges, a lower filter cartridge that slides prismatically forward, and a black folding handle recessed in the top face that rotates upwards on pivots.
captions.factory: Create the main body as a hollowed rectangular box with a top recess for the handle and a front cutout for the door and filter. Model the front door and the filter cartridge as separate solid parts, positioning the filter at the bottom. Define a revolute joint for the side-hinged door, a prismatic joint for the sliding filter cartridge, and a revolute joint for the top handle pivot.
